Initial state:

   and stopLoss omitted.

- Same-key/same-request retry returns the same status and byte-equivalent body.

## Proposed file

Target: `tests/contract/http/orders_idempotency_test.go`

The unresolved constants and handler constructor must be replaced from the frozen contract and repository interfaces before applying this file. The failing constructor is deliberate and visible; it must not remain in a completed port.

```go
package httpcontract_test

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"
)

const (
	// Confirm these exact contract identities from the pinned source test or
	// frozen contract before accepting the port.
	idempotencyHeader = "Idempotency-Key"
	commandIDJSONKey  = "__UNAVAILABLE_COMMAND_ID_JSON_KEY__"
	errorCodeJSONKey  = "__UNAVAILABLE_ERROR_CODE_JSON_KEY__"
)

// Ported from:
//   repository: <UNAVAILABLE_SOURCE_REPOSITORY>@<UNAVAILABLE_PINNED_REVISION>
//   source: <UNAVAILABLE_SOURCE_FILE>:<UNAVAILABLE_SOURCE_LINE>
//   test: <UNAVAILABLE_SOURCE_TEST_FUNCTION>
// Adaptations:
//   - Source HTTP stack replaced by the production-composed Go HTTP handler.
//   - Responses captured synchronously with httptest.
// Assertions preserved:
//   - Initial request returns 201, quantity "0.0100", stopLoss: null,
//     and command ID "cmd-7".
//   - Same-key/same-request retry returns byte-equivalent status and body.
//   - Same-key/different-request returns 409 and
//     IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED.
func TestCreateOrder_IdempotencyReplayAndKeyReuse(t *testing.T) {
	handler := newOrdersContractHandler(t)

	const (
		firstRequest = `{"quantity":"0.0100"}`
		changedRequest = `{"quantity":"0.0200"}`
	)

	firstStatus, firstBody := postOrder(
		t,
		handler,
		"same-key",
		[]byte(firstRequest),
	)
	if firstStatus != http.StatusCreated {
		t.Fatalf("first response status = %d, want %d; body=%s",
			firstStatus, http.StatusCreated, firstBody)
	}

	firstJSON := decodeJSONObject(t, firstBody)

	requireJSONString(t, firstJSON, "quantity", "0.0100")
	requireJSONString(t, firstJSON, commandIDJSONKey, "cmd-7")
	requireJSONNull(t, firstJSON, "stopLoss")

	retryStatus, retryBody := postOrder(
		t,
		handler,
		"same-key",
		[]byte(firstRequest),
	)
	if retryStatus != firstStatus {
		t.Fatalf("retry status = %d, want stored status %d",
			retryStatus, firstStatus)
	}
	if !bytes.Equal(retryBody, firstBody) {
		t.Fatalf(
			"retry body is not byte-equivalent:\nfirst: %q\nretry: %q",
			firstBody,
			retryBody,
		)
	}

	conflictStatus, conflictBody := postOrder(
		t,
		handler,
		"same-key",
		[]byte(changedRequest),
	)
	if conflictStatus != http.StatusConflict {
		t.Fatalf("key-reuse status = %d, want %d; body=%s",
			conflictStatus, http.StatusConflict, conflictBody)
	}

	conflictJSON := decodeJSONObject(t, conflictBody)
	requireJSONString(
		t,
		conflictJSON,
		errorCodeJSONKey,
		"IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED",
	)
}

func postOrder(
	t *testing.T,
	handler http.Handler,
	idempotencyKey string,
	body []byte,
) (int, []byte) {
	t.Helper()

	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/v1/orders", bytes.NewReader(body))
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	req.Header.Set(idempotencyHeader, idempotencyKey)

	recorder := httptest.NewRecorder()
	handler.ServeHTTP(recorder, req)

	response := recorder.Result()
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		_ = response.Body.Close()
	})

	responseBody, err := io.ReadAll(response.Body)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("read response body: %v", err)
	}

	return response.StatusCode, responseBody
}

func decodeJSONObject(t *testing.T, body []byte) map[string]json.RawMessage {
	t.Helper()

	var value map[string]json.RawMessage
	if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &value); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("decode response as JSON object: %v; body=%q", err, body)
	}
	if value == nil {
		t.Fatalf("response is JSON null, want object; body=%q", body)
	}

	return value
}

func requireJSONString(
	t *testing.T,
	object map[string]json.RawMessage,
	field string,
	want string,
) {
	t.Helper()

	raw, present := object[field]
	if !present {
		t.Fatalf("response field %q is omitted", field)
	}

	var got string
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &got); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("response field %q is not a JSON string: %s", field, raw)
	}
	if got != want {
		t.Fatalf("response field %q = %q, want %q", field, got, want)
	}
}

func requireJSONNull(
	t *testing.T,
	object map[string]json.RawMessage,
	field string,
) {
	t.Helper()

	raw, present := object[field]
	if !present {
		t.Fatalf("response field %q is omitted, want explicit null", field)
	}
	if !bytes.Equal(bytes.TrimSpace(raw), []byte("null")) {
		t.Fatalf("response field %q = %s, want null", field, raw)
	}
}

// newOrdersContractHandler is the only repository-specific wiring point.
// Replace it with the production HTTP composition used by existing contract
// tests. Do not retain this sentinel in an accepted port.
func newOrdersContractHandler(t *testing.T) http.Handler {
	t.Helper()
	t.Fatal("production order-handler constructor is unavailable in the supplied fixture")
	return nil
}
```
